PC2.hypothesis: A counter-direction 15m pullback to session value in an aligned trend can resume toward already observed nearby opposition; use the original 45m pullback structure for invalidation.
PC2.formation_clock: new closed 15m bar only; one active setup per symbol and side
PC2.regime: c03.context.v1 READY TREND_UP for LONG / TREND_DOWN for SHORT; ATR percentile <95
PC2.target: nearest directionally ahead formation-confirmed 1h swing OR highest/lowest of latest20 closed1h bars; no farther level may replace a nearer one
PC2.confirmation: first of next3 distinct closed5m bars with directional body and close beyond formation15m high/low; cancel if fixed stop touched first, missing/extreme context, opposite4h bias or UTC VWAP session changes
PC2.stop: min(low of last3 closed15m)-0.25*frozenATR15 LONG; max(high)+0.25*frozenATR15 SHORT

FR2.hypothesis: A first failed break of an already tested low-drift five-hour range, followed by a distinct acceptance close, can rotate toward the range midpoint before invalidating the sweep.
FR2.formation_clock: new closed15m bar; one active range per symbol and side; never re-arm on same15m bar
FR2.regime: c03 context READY; ADX1h<25; abs(normalizedEMA1h slope)<=0.30; ATR percentile<95; current15m RVOL breakout in either direction disqualifies
FR2.sweep: first subsequent5m breach of own edge must close strictly inside frozen range and meet penetration bounds; any two-sided full-range bar or failed first breach invalidates
FR2.confirmation: exactly next distinct5m close beyond sweep high/low with directional body; invalidate first if original sweep stop touched, close fails to stay strictly inside range, missing/extreme context; no later retry
FR2.stop: sweep low-0.25*frozenATR15 LONG; sweep high+0.25*frozenATR15 SHORT
FR2.target: nearest directionally ahead formation-confirmed1h opposing swing OR frozen range midpoint; no farther target replaces nearer opposition
FR2.expiry: no sweep by third5m close expires; third-bar sweep permits only fourth-bar confirmation

common.entry_reference: hypothetical confirmation close; never a fill; forward starts next5m open at availability(close+1ms)
common.history_limits: unchanged C05-J HISTORY_LIMITS and c03.context.v1; source_end_exclusive=2024-10-01T00:00:00Z
common.costs: unchanged C05-K cost_screen; one target fraction1; policy not R1 so no old midpoint extra screen
common.holding: flatten attempt at earliest confirmed fill+11h55; hard12h emergency; clocks never reset
common.execution: one-use authenticated human bounded preapproval; confirmation+10s IOC deadline; adverse cap=min(2 dated ticks,0.10 frozenATR5,0.05 originalR); skip absent approval or evidence
common.risk: per-trade<=0.25% reconciled equity; total pending+open<=0.50%; two slots; one position/symbol; isolated<=2x; daily1% entry halt; no scale-in, no widening; exactly one writer
common.quantity: per-base-unit R0 only; later round_down(min(0.0025*equity,remaining_stop_risk)/(adverse_stop_distance+cost_allowance),step), independently cap filters, margin, notional and leverage; never assume a reconciled account
common.qualification: No approved registry entry or activation in S01; owner approval before S04 implementation

matching.pc_nontrigger: no active PC2 at cutoff and no fresh PC2 formation; trend regime on relevant side
matching.fr_nontrigger: price-balance regime; no sweep/pending confirmation/terminal trigger at cutoff; an unswept armed range is permitted
matching.normalization: control own close; transplant case stop and target FRACTIONS only for path comparability; never a control policy

r0_decision.source_dependent: essential price trigger cannot be measured legitimately
r0_decision.reject: at least20 confirmations and zero base-cost-and-geometry survivors OR at least20 full12h base survivors and target-before-stop UPPER<=0.20
r0_decision.advance: at least20 full12h base survivors on>=8UTC days and>=4symbols; base survivors>=10% of confirmations; target-before-stop LOWER>=0.35; matched>=50% of complete survivors on>=8event days; equal-day signed case-control mean>0 at1h and4h and>=0 at12h; 4h leave-one-day-out lower>0
r0_decision.priority: ADVANCE before REVISE before SOURCE_DEPENDENT before REJECT; tie: larger4h equal-day contrast, then lower base costR, then PC2
